correctness.rationale: The primitive quintic equation vanishes under the base-point-free degree-five parametrization in every characteristic. A degree-five morphism whose image is not a line is birational onto an integral quintic. The symbolic cross-product factorization identifies the ramification parameters. Exact local coordinate changes give coprime characteristic pairs (2,7), (3,4) and (2,13); genus six exhausts all singularities. The Gauss rational inverse for characteristic !=2, and the characteristic-two [1:0:u^4] formula, prove the degree statements. All encoded polynomial equalities were actually replayed with the bundled script.

value.rationale: The unique maximally cuspidal complex plane quintic is an intrinsically motivated object. The classification identifies exactly which primes cause coalescence of its four cusps, the complete local delta and branch-semigroup profiles, and a sharp change from a birational quartic Gauss map to a purely inseparable degree-four map onto a line. This demonstrates a genuinely characteristic-dependent degeneration of tangency geometry, rather than a routine finite search or numerical increment.
